rows.grounds: fused sandhi form: nirgamau + vā + api

items.question: In what manner must inhalation and exhalation be performed within this prescribed practice?
premises: The practice includes the act of entry.
The practice also includes the act of exit.
The same prescribed manner applies to both acts.
items.inference: Therefore, the practitioner should perform both entry and exit in that very same manner.
uncertainties: Whether praveśa and nirgamau refer specifically to breath or to a more general movement depends on the broader ritual context.
items.plain_english: One should practice the entry and also the exit in just the same way.
